trigger: The unchanged tiered policy beat both pooled endpoints at 0.75 and 1 percent, but tied the loose blend at 0.75 percent and trailed it by one row at 1 percent. This extension tests whether the environment gate prevents harmful corroboration overrides under severe retrieval drift. No 4- or 8-percent counter-retrieval evidence report existed when this amendment was recorded.
provenance: Post-label method development. The clean calibration, tier thresholds, evidence semantics, and routing actions remain unchanged; only the evaluated rate scope expands.

unchanged_policy.normal: Loose directional leave-original-out corroboration over answerability when the clean posterior-predictive upper tail is greater than 0.01.
unchanged_policy.warning: Unopposed direct leave-original-out corroboration over answerability when the tail is at most 0.01 and greater than 0.0001.
unchanged_policy.critical: Answerability fallback with no retrieval-based override when the tail is at most 0.0001.

rate_extension.activation: All same-model RAG/internal-majority disagreements at each rate.
rate_extension.purpose: Compare the frozen tiered gate with always-loose and always-strict corroboration under severe drift. Counter reports are collected even for critical cells solely to provide those matched ablations; the tiered policy is not allowed to inspect them in critical mode.
required_reporting: tiered versus loose, strict, answerability, RAG, and model-only
switch gains and regressions with claim-clustered uncertainty
counter-view poison exposure, calls, tokens, retries, and failures
